summary: Implemented the ui half of PRD_VIEWER_CLARITY. The changes are in src/projects and tests/project-workflows only, and nothing was committed. What was built: (1) Executor marks. EXECUTOR_LABEL, executorCategory and executorOf are in status.ts. Every graph node gets the class is-agent or is-controller, a dashed stroke-dasharray attribute for the verifier and controller, the executor in its meta line and aria-label, and there is a three-entry graph-legend. NodeDetail has an 'Executed by' fact, and a review node says 'one print job per reviewer' when the served review's transport is print. (2) NodeDetail is split into ProducedEvidence (launch node: result facts and created files, then completion, launch receipt and the task in a closed <details data-testid=task-details>) and VerifiedEvidence (verify node and candidate lanes: result facts, a gate section with deferred checks and ownership, checks with logs, screenshots, and other artifacts other than file artifacts). The candidate lanes link to the launch node's files. (3) New CreatedFiles.tsx renders 'Files created or changed': Markdown inline through src/document/Markdown.tsx, other text as source on demand, files_not_captured with their reasons, and a legacy message when nothing was captured. (4) findingsForFile and linesNamed are in findings.ts. Each captured file lists the findings that name it, with a 'show lines' control that switches to the source, sets data-finding-line on the lines and scrolls to them. Review findings that name a captured file link to its panel on the launch node. (5) ReviewDetail has a 'reviewer' grouping: declared order, labels with id, verdict and severity counts, a hidden guard group, reviewer as the default when there are several reviewers, and the reviewer filter works with every grouping. (6) New scroll.ts keepInView keeps a handed-over target in view while content above it loads. (7) Fixtures and seeds have a new clarity-flow workflow with run run-files-captured (file artifacts for a .md and a .ts, too_large and binary entries, findings with and without line ranges plus one similar path). Existing runs are unchanged. (8) New clarity.spec.ts has one test per scenario id. finding-to-task is extended for the disclosure. worker-inputs, inputs-paths-redacted, viewer-three-lanes, legacy-run, run-evidence and viewer-two-reviewers were changed where the PRD moves things: the task is now collapsed, checks moved to the verify node, and several reviewers now open grouped by reviewer. CHECKS RUN IN THIS WORKTREE: npm run build FAILED (exit 1, 24 TS errors). All come from the file kind missing in contracts/workflow/v1.ts, e.g. "src/projects/NodeDetail.tsx(150,88): error TS2367: ... '\"log\" | \"other\" | \"patch\" | \"test_report\"' and '\"file\"' have no overlap" and "src/projects/files.ts(14,56): error TS2339: Property 'files_not_captured' does not exist". npm run test:unit PASSED (130/130). The project-workflows browser suite FAILED in both phases (worker and candidate, exit 1) before any test ran. fixtures.ts validates the new result at import and gets ZodError invalid_value: 'Invalid option: expected one of "patch"|"log"|"screenshot"|"test_report"|"other"'. SUPPLEMENTARY CHECK, not a gate: a scratch copy outside the worktree was set up with a local shim of the PRD 4.1 contract. The shim adds the file kind with path, adds files_not_captured, and makes the server pass files_not_captured through and serve file artifacts as text/plain. There, tsc -b and eslint passed, and the browser suite passed 26/26 in both the worker and candidate phases, including all six new scenarios and every existing one. One earlier worker-phase run in the scratch copy had a transient 'Page crashed' in empty-states, which passed on rerun. The combined candidate with the adapter's real schema was not run here.
open_assumptions: A finding names a file only as a whole path: the characters around it must not be part of a path, so docs/a.md does not match src/docs/a.md or docs/a.mdx. A trailing period or a :N / :N-M suffix still counts. An en dash is also accepted in ranges.

The type code assumes the adapter's schema gives artifacts an optional path and kind 'file', and gives results an optional files_not_captured of {path, reason} with the four reasons, as pinned in PRD 4.1. A differently shaped type would need small adjustments in files.ts.

The served result has no ownership field. The verify view's 'ownership outcome' is derived: worker phase means ownership was enforced, and passed or not follows the gate status and error. Candidate lanes say ownership is enforced per lane, not at the candidate.
Required-check links in the task now go to the verify_<lane> node, because the launch node no longer has a checks table. The link carries data-check-index but does not scroll to the check.
A captured file whose path is not in changed_files is still listed. A changed file in a capture-era result with neither an artifact nor a reason says 'not captured, and no reason was recorded'.

The graph meta line uses short words (agent, verifier, controller) and is squeezed to the node width with textLength when it is long. The legend and item layout use inline styles, because stylesheets were out of scope.
Reviewer groups with no visible findings are hidden, like every other grouping, so a reviewer with no findings, or one filtered out, has no group.
Existing specs were updated for the behaviour the PRD changes: the collapsed task, checks moved off the launch node, and reviewer as the default grouping.
